Name: Lady Isolde Vance 
Role in Community: Landowner / Noble. 
Appearance: Dressed in finer clothes than most villagers, carries herself with an air of superiority. Elegant but sharp features. 
Personality Archetype: The Manipulator / The Elitist

Name: Silas "Shadow" Croft 
Role in Community: Hunter / Trapper / Scout.

Personality Archetype: The Quiet Observer / The Cynic

player-bf42f882-aa0c-4ab8-9894-22deae4d9.persona:
Name: Gideon Blackwood 
Role in Community: Retired Captain of the Village Guard, serves on informal village council. 
Appearance: Stern face etched with wrinkles, sharp eyes, grey neatly-kept beard, sturdy build though slightly stooped. Wears practical, dark, well-maintained woolen clothes. Carries himself with authority. 
Personality Archetype: The Leader / The Guardian 
Key Traits: Direct, Authoritative, Confidence 9/10, Suspicion 8/10, Honesty 8/10. 
Motivations: Maintain order, Eliminate the threat decisively.
